title: epan: Return unsigned lengths from proto API
description:
The return length is always non-negative; a negative 1 input used
currently for variable length is always converted to its true value.

Also use unsigned length in _ret_varint. Negative 1 maps to a really
big positive integer, which is fine because of how the functiion
clamps the maximum possible length anyway.

Ping #20103
